resources.string: The cheats could not be saved

This game\'s cheat codes: GameShark, Action Replay and CodeBreaker codes (GBA), GameShark codes (PS1, N64), Xbox memory codes (TAAAAAAA VVVVVVVV: 0, 1, 2 write 8, 16, 32 bits; 4, 5, 6 run the next line if the value matches) or ADDRESS:VALUE. Turn each on or off, add or delete one; a running game takes a change at once (its in-game menu has the same page).
Code: one line per code line, e.g. 8003A2C4 0063
Code: one line per code line, e.g. 2001A2B4 0000270F
A code is made of hexadecimal digits (0-9, A-F).
Each line: AAAAAAAA VVVVVVVV, AAAAAAAA VVVV or ADDRESS:VALUE.
Each line: AAAAAAAA VVVV (GameShark) or ADDRESS:VALUE.
Each line: TAAAAAAA VVVVVVVV (T: 0, 1, 2 write; 4, 5, 6 test, then a line) or ADDRESS:VALUE.
Each line: AAAAAAAA VVVVVVVV (Action Replay or Gecko) or ADDRESS:VALUE.
Encrypted Action Replay codes (XXXX-XXXX-XXXXX) are not supported: enter the decrypted code (AAAAAAAA VVVVVVVV).
Each line: ADDRESS VALUE or ADDRESS:VALUE (a raw 32-bit write, big-endian; data only).
